Higham projection ensures that multivariate dependencies remain mathematically valid, preventing arbitrage opportunities arising from rank-deficient covariance matrices. Vine copulas then efficiently calibrate these dependencies against parlay prices, while the Bayesian robust Kelly fraction optimizes capital allocation under posterior uncertainty. Together, they enforce a rigorous separation between signal discovery and actionable trades, mitigating overfitting and ensuring long-term profitability.
